description: Build a synthetic-safe Kinect v2 / FreenectTD projected wall harp in an isolated Base COMP. The network can create a FreenectTOP depth path when explicitly enabled, listen to an external OSC Kinect bridge with source='osc_kinect', or build a synthetic fallback. It extracts left/right hand centroids, divides the projection into configurable musical zones, triggers short electronic plucks on zone entry, renders a denser vibrating curtain of projected strings, and exposes depth/mask/hands/audio plus bridge-status diagnostics. If FreenectTD or Kinect hardware is unavailable, the tool returns warnings instead of throwing, so the visual/audio/trigger chain can still be tested offline.

activate_freenect.description: Safety gate for actually creating/activating FreenectTOP. Default false because FreenectTD Kinect v2 initialization is unstable on the validated macOS setup; leave false for crash-safe synthetic fallback.

audio_device.description: Optional Audio Device Out device name. Leave empty to keep TouchDesigner's default device.

audio_sample_rate.description: Script CHOP audio sample rate. Set to 192000 when using UMC202HD at 192k.

background_level.description: Neutral projected background brightness; 0.0 leaves the wall unlit behind the laser lines.

bridge_status_json.description: JSON status path written by scripts/kinect-wall-harp-bridge.mjs --status-json and read by the generated bridge_status DAT.

brightness.description: Very subtle harmonic color for the generated sine pluck tone.

calibration_hold_ms.description: Milliseconds a hand must remain stable on a calibration target before auto-capture.

curtain_follow.description: How strongly nearby visual lines bend around tracked wall-touch hands.

curtain_spread.description: How many neighboring visual lines share vibration from each musical zone.

deactivate_existing_freenect.description: Deactivate existing FreenectTOP nodes under parent_path before starting the new Kinect source. Kinect v2 is a single-device path, so this avoids multiple active FreenectTD nodes competing for the same sensor.

depth_polarity.description: Which side of the wall-depth band should count as touch candidates.

expose_controls.description: Expose calibration, harp, audio, and visual controls on the generated COMP.

fallback_to_synthetic.description: When true, missing FreenectTD/Kinect hardware still creates a playable synthetic fallback with warnings.

frequencies.description: Pluck frequencies for the musical trigger zones.

glow.description: Visual glow multiplier for active strings.

input_bottom.description: Raw normalized Kinect Y that maps to the projector's bottom edge.

input_left.description: Raw normalized Kinect X that maps to the projector's left edge.

input_mirror_x.description: Mirror normalized hand X after OSC input, before projector-space calibration.

input_right.description: Raw normalized Kinect X that maps to the projector's right edge.

input_top.description: Raw normalized Kinect Y that maps to the projector's top edge.

master_volume.description: Overall gain for the internal pluck Script CHOP.

name.description: Name for the generated Base COMP under parent_path.

osc_port.description: UDP port for OSC Kinect hand input when source='osc_kinect'.

output_height.description: Height for generated debug and projected output TOPs.

output_width.description: Width for generated debug and projected output TOPs.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP path where the isolated kinect_wall_harp Base COMP is created.

reverb_damping.description: High-frequency damping for the internal algorithmic reverb.

reverb_decay.description: Feedback decay for the internal algorithmic reverb.

reverb_mix.description: Wet reverb mix for the internal pluck synth.

sensitivity.description: Blob threshold / cleanup aggressiveness for the wall-touch mask.

show_debug.description: When true, the visual Script TOP draws hand dots and zone guides.

smoothing.description: Hand centroid smoothing amount used by the tracking Script CHOP.

source.description: Input source. 'freenect' tries the FreenectTD FreenectTOP Kinect v2 path; 'synthetic' builds a device-free wall-touch simulator; 'osc_kinect' listens for normalized Kinect hand points from an external OSC bridge.

string_count.description: Number of musical trigger zones across the projected wall harp.

vibration_amount.description: Maximum horizontal string vibration in pixels.

visual_line_count.description: Number of visible projected laser lines. Can exceed string_count for curtain behavior.

wall_depth_center.description: Normalized depth value representing the calibrated wall/touch plane.

title: Create Kinect wall harp
